articles.title: A16z is the latest VC giant to widen bets beyond crypto and into AI and emerging tech
articles.snippet: The venture investor behind early bets on Coinbase, Solana and Uniswap said is broadening its focus, joining other crypto investment firms looking beyond blockchain to artificial intelligence and tech themes.

articles.title: Irish central bank fines Coinbase Ireland $3.6 million over fund safeguarding failures
articles.snippet: When Silvergate was on the verge of collapse in 2023, Coinbase instructed 30 customers to deposit funds into an alternate account held by Coinbase at another U.S. bank.

articles.title: Crypto for Advisors: Stablecoins are ready for prime time
Crypto is making a splash in U.S. elections — but chiefly in jabs about industry influence
articles.snippet: Boosters often say crypto voters can swing elections, but Democrats are seeking mileage out of tying crypto to Trump, corruption and attempts to buy seats in Congress.

articles.title: Ethereum’s four-minute settlement plan could lower the cost of moving crypto
articles.snippet: A new draft targets a fourfold cut in the time it takes Ethereum transactions to become final, which could free up money transfer services tie up while customers’ payments clear.
